points.description: States that the best-case scenario for insertion sort occurs when the array is already sorted (in ascending order). Accept equivalent wording such as 'sorted array' or 'array is in order'.

States that the number of operations in the best case is N, where N is the length/size of the array. Accept 'N operations' or equivalent linear-time statement such as O(N)/linear time, provided N is identified as the array length or the answer clearly means the input size. Do not accept N^2 or quadratic time.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the best-case condition (already sorted array) and the operation count N (array length). If the answer gives only one of these, award only the corresponding point. Answers claiming N^2 operations or a reverse-sorted best case do not earn the relevant point.
